get.description:
Public deployment-scoped Ed25519 keys only. Pin this deployment’s JWKS origin and require alg EdDSA, iss tidb-link/connector-callback/v1, aud tidb-link/connector, the receiving organizationId and connectorId, and a current exp with exp - iat <= 60 seconds. Cache these public keys for local verification. Tokens may be reused within their scope and expiry; they grant no platform API, tunnel or business-account authority and do not sign Call Context.

Authorization: public; no credentials required. Verification keys grant no platform authority.

503.description: provider_unavailable: callback signing material is unavailable; no unsigned or shared-secret fallback.

get.summary: Get public verification keys for HTTP Connector callback JWTs.

OrganizationApiKey.description: Opaque ti_org_<id>_<secret> credential: ASCII alphanumeric id body (1–64), unpadded base64url secret (43 characters from 32 random bytes). Authenticates an Organization machine principal with no acting User. Each handler explicitly chooses whether to admit this principal kind.
